course_rules: Biology transformative learning requirement:
Select at least one from all biology (BIOL and BIOZ) courses that are approved as REAL level 3 or 4 transformative learning experiences
Major electives:

All 300-, 400-, and 500-level courses, other than the 4 core courses (BIOL 300, BIOL 310, BIOL 317, BIOL 318), will count towards the major electives degree requirement, in addition to the courses in the tables below. All majors must complete at minimum three additional upper-level biology lab courses. The laboratory experiences may be fulfilled by a separate laboratory section (BIOZ) or by laboratory hours included in a lecture-based (BIOL) course listed in the table below. Not all courses are offered each semester. BIOL courses at the 500 level are available to seniors and graduate students only.
